info.title: BallotData API
info.summary: U.S. ballots, endorsers and endorsements, and a live stream of endorsement changes.
info.description:
Ballot races (elections, contests and their choices), endorsers and endorsements across the U.S., who holds office now, and a stream of endorsement changes.

Everything is JSON over HTTPS. Send your API key on every request as `Authorization: Bearer ebk_…`. Lists are paged: `{ "data": [...], "next_cursor": "…" }`; pass `cursor` for the next page. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message", "request_id" } }`.

Address and geography lookups (the ballot at an address, districts and boundaries, representatives by location) have been retired: choose races by state, election or contest.

tags.name: Elections
tags.description: States, elections and coverage: what there is to ask about.

tags.name: Contests
tags.description: The races on a ballot and their choices: candidates, or Yes/No for a measure. Contests carry their voting rules: vote for one, vote for N (votes_allowed), ranked choice (ranks_allowed), or yes/no, and their election results once a source has them: official counts from election offices, certified returns compiled by researchers for past elections, or a party’s announcement of the winner, always with the source’s URL.

tags.name: Endorsers
tags.description: Who endorses: unions, newspapers, parties, clubs, advocacy groups and officials, by category and home state.

tags.name: Endorsements
tags.description: Who each endorser backs in each race, and every change to those endorsements.

tags.name: Candidates
tags.description: The people on the ballot, every endorsement each one received, and where they stand on common issues.

tags.name: Officeholders
tags.description: Who holds each seat now, from Open States.

tags.name: Stream
tags.description: Every endorsement added, changed or removed, as Server-Sent Events or by polling. Needs the stream:read scope and a plan that includes the stream.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Saved filters for the stream and events. Reading needs stream:read; changing needs subscriptions:write.

get.description: Every state, D.C. and territory, with its USPS and FIPS codes. Use the codes in states= filters.

x-codeSamples.label: curl
x-codeSamples.source:
curl "https://api.ballotdata.ai/v1/states" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BALLOTDATA_API_KEY"

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript
Python
x-codeSamples.source:
from ballotdata import BallotData

client = BallotData()  # reads BALLOTDATA_API_KEY
states = client.states.list()

get.description: Elections, with their voting rules in details (all-mail, ranked choice, fusion, runoff dates) and how many contests, endorsements and results each has. Past elections kept for their results (the November 5, 2024 general in every state) are listed too, with details.historical; upcoming=true leaves them out. Use an election’s slug to ask for its contests or endorsements.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: USPS codes. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Kinds of election (general, primary, special, runoff and so on). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: upcoming
parameters.description: true for only elections from yesterday on; false (the default) for every election.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Elections on or after this date.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Elections on or before this date.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: es for Spanish ballot text (titles, choices, measure text, statements) where the state publishes it; English otherwise. Names are never translated.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1–500.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Where the next page starts: the next_cursor from the previous page. Leave it out for the first page; it is opaque, so pass it back exactly as you got it.

200.description: A page of elections, by id.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor= for the next page; null on the last page.

get.description: The races on the ballot, each with its district, its election, its voting rules, every choice in ballot order and, once a source has one, its result (votes for each choice and the winners). Filter by election, state, level, kind, district or result. To see who endorsed whom, use GET /v1/contests/{id} or /v1/endorsements.

parameters.name: elections
parameters.description: Election slugs (GET /v1/elections). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: States the contests are voted in (USPS codes). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Levels of the contest’s district, from federal down to school and special districts. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: contest_kinds
parameters.description: Contest kinds: candidate (an office), measure, or retention (whether to keep a judge). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: districts
parameters.description: OCD division ids of the contests’ districts. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: upcoming
parameters.description: true for only elections from yesterday on; false (the default) for every election.

parameters.name: has_result
parameters.description: true for only contests with a result; false for only contests without one yet. Leave it out for both.

parameters.name: result_statuses
parameters.description: Only contests whose result has one of these statuses: unofficial (counts still changing) or certified. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: es for Spanish ballot text (titles, choices, measure text, statements) where the state publishes it; English otherwise. Names are never translated.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1–200.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Where the next page starts: the next_cursor from the previous page. Leave it out for the first page; it is opaque, so pass it back exactly as you got it.

get.description:
Every endorsement change matching a subscription or inline filter, as Server-Sent Events, within seconds of it happening. Events: ready (first, with the subscription name), endorsement (an Event), checkpoint (moves your position past changes your filter skipped), reconnect (we end connections after an hour), and error (cursor_expired). A comment line arrives every 20 seconds.

Each event id is a cursor: reconnect with Last-Event-ID (EventSource does this itself) or ?cursor= to continue. Cursors work on /v1/events too. Without one you start at the newest change (from=latest); from=earliest or since= start further back. A cursor older than the stream keeps (7 days, at most 50,000 changes) ends the stream with an error event, cursor_expired, or gets 410 before it opens. There is no limit on how many streams you hold open.

The Endorsement Stream ends at the close of December 31, 2027 (Pacific).

parameters.name: subscription
parameters.description: A saved subscription’s id or name (GET /v1/subscriptions). Use it instead of the filter parameters below, not together with them.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Endorser category slugs (GET /v1/endorser-categories). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: elections

parameters.name: contest_kinds
parameters.description: Contest kinds: candidate (an office), measure, or retention (whether to keep a judge). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Levels of the contest’s district, from federal down to school and special districts. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Kinds of change: created (a new endorsement), updated (one that changed) or deleted (one withdrawn or removed). All three by default. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Resume after this position: a next_cursor from /v1/events or an event id from /v1/stream (either works on both). Also read from the Last-Event-ID header. Takes precedence over since and from. Opaque; valid for 7 days.

parameters.name: from

parameters.name: since

get.description:
The same changes as GET /v1/stream, a page at a time, for servers that can’t hold a connection open (cron jobs, serverless functions, strict firewalls). Each response has the changes after your cursor that match your filter, oldest first, and a next_cursor (even when there are none): store it and send it as cursor next time. has_more means more are waiting, so call again right away. wait (up to 25 seconds) holds a request with nothing new open until a matching change arrives (long polling).

Without a cursor you start at the newest change (from=latest); from=earliest or since= start further back. Cursors work on /v1/stream too. A cursor older than the stream keeps (7 days, at most 50,000 changes) gets 410 cursor_expired: catch up with GET /v1/endorsements, then start again with from=latest.

The Endorsement Stream ends at the close of December 31, 2027 (Pacific).

parameters.name: subscription
parameters.description: A saved subscription’s id or name (GET /v1/subscriptions). Use it instead of the filter parameters below, not together with them.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Endorser category slugs (GET /v1/endorser-categories). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: endorsers
parameters.description: Endorser slugs (GET /v1/endorsers). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: endorser_states
parameters.description: Endorsers’ home states (USPS codes), or national for endorsers with none. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: States the contests are voted in (USPS codes). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: elections
parameters.description: Election slugs (GET /v1/elections). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: contest_kinds
parameters.description: Contest kinds: candidate (an office), measure, or retention (whether to keep a judge). Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Levels of the contest’s district, from federal down to school and special districts. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Kinds of change: created (a new endorsement), updated (one that changed) or deleted (one withdrawn or removed). All three by default. Comma-separated (up to 200 values); any of them matches.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Resume after this position: a next_cursor from /v1/events or an event id from /v1/stream (either works on both). Also read from the Last-Event-ID header. Takes precedence over since and from. Opaque; valid for 7 days.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Where to start without a cursor or since: latest (only changes from now on) or earliest (the oldest change the stream still holds, up to 7 days back).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Start at the first change at or after this time (ISO 8601). Must be within the last 7 days, or you get 410 cursor_expired. Use instead of cursor.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events per page, 1–1000. has_more in the response says more are waiting.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Seconds to hold the request open when nothing new matches (long polling), 0–25. 0 answers at once.

has_more.description: More are waiting: call again now.
